ns2:course.label: Iterative & Multigrid Methods
ns2:course.description: Comprehensive treatment of algebraic and multigrid iterative methods to solve systems of equations, primarily linear equations arising from discretization of partial differential equations. Same as CSE 511.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, NDEG:Computer Science Onl-UIUC, or MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC.
